decisions: A buy limit includes producer price, actual freight and tariff in the existing common CR settlement currency.
Confirmed buy orders hold an escrow asset; confirmed sells reserve only the seller's identified lots.
The public call market matches lowest asks first. Competing eligible bids at each ask share scarce supply proportionally; seeded residual allocation is independent of UI submission order.
An order is an instruction, not a completed sale. Unfilled quantity persists until expiry or explicit cancellation.
One matched shipment transfers ownership at dispatch. Payment, freight, tariff and physical delivery are separate recorded events.
Public specifications are product and variant identifiers. This module never reveals private rival inventory or research.
